A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was stationed on the remote desert planet of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].

==Biography==
The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] was a member of a special [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] task force stationed on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their mission was to acquire as much [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] as possible and to deliver it to a stolen [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] called the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]''. Their ultimate objective was to blow up a Republican Conference starship, where an important war meeting was taking place, by ramming into it.

When [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] needed to get to the Republic cruiser, they needed to get a ship. They decided that they should try to board the ship that was carrying the rhydonium to the cruiser with the help of Gregor, a clone commando that suffered from amnesia. When they got close to the Separatist station they were halted by this droid, who asked to show him their authorization. He and the other B1 battle droid were shot by [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], destroying them both.
